component.name: Sensorium
component.summary: Private remote workstation for two machines

description.p: Sensorium is a private remote workstation for two machines. You sit at this one, the viewer, and work on a virtual display the other machine creates for you. With permission granted at that machine, you can also see and control one of its real screens.
The two machines talk directly over their own Tailscale tailnet. There is no account, no relay, no telemetry and no command line. This package is the viewer. The machine being worked on runs macOS.
